title: Save answers and look them up
hints: Two places are wrong: what gets saved for each pair, and what happens when the name was never saved.
The save should store `v`, the pair's own value: `Hashtbl.replace env k v`.
`Hashtbl.find` stops the program on a missing key. Use `match Hashtbl.find_opt env name with Some v -> v | None -> 0`.
explain: The reference saves each pair with `Hashtbl.replace env k v`, so a later pair with the same name replaces the earlier one. Then it looks the name up with `Hashtbl.find_opt`, which gives `Some v` when the name is there and `None` when it is not, and returns 0 for `None`.
